h1: Custom Small Lanyards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom small lanyards in bulk for your team or event. Perfect for IDs, keys, and badges. Fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Small lanyards offer a compact, lightweight solution for ID badges, keys, and access cards. Unlike standard-length lanyards, these shorter options reduce bulk and prevent dangling, making them ideal for children, retail staff, or anyone who prefers a low-profile carry. Choose from materials like woven polyester, nylon web, or PVC plastic, and decorate with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation. The 3/4" Knit-In Lanyard and 3/8" Knit-In Lanyard are popular choices for a secure, comfortable fit.
heroAltText: Bulk custom small lanyards in assorted colors with printed logos and badge clips
